text: Kicking off the Neon migration spike this week. Goal is branch-per-PR databases so we stop stepping on each other in staging.
This is the thing I've wanted for a year. Staging has been a single shared Postgres since forever and every schema change is a negotiation.
What's the rough cost envelope? I don't want to find out in the June invoice.
Napkin math says about 400 a month at our branch volume. I'll validate during the spike.
Reminder that our connection pooling is PgBouncer in transaction mode. Anything we migrate to has to keep working with that or a lot of app code changes.
Noted. Adding it to the spike checklist.
